description: This file defines functions for translating JIT schema representations into C++ API types for PyTorch, including handling argument types, return types, default expressions, and naming conventions within the C++ API translation layer.

methods.name: str name( func: FunctionSchema, *, faithful_name_for_out_overloads: bool = False, symint_overload: bool = False, )
methods.description: Generates a function name string for a given schema, optionally including overload suffixes based on output or out-parameter status.

methods.name: NamedCType|None valuetype_type( t: Type, *, binds: ArgName, mutable: bool = True, symint: bool = False, )
methods.description: Translates JIT schema value types to C++ NamedCType, handling optional types, list types, and base types like Tensor and Scalar.

methods.name: NamedCType argumenttype_type( t: Type, *, mutable: bool, binds: ArgName, remove_non_owning_ref_types: bool = False, symint: bool = False, )
methods.description: Converts a JIT schema argument type into a C++ argument type, considering mutability, reference types, and special cases like List and Optional types.

methods.name: NamedCType argument_type(a: Argument, *, binds: ArgName, symint: bool = False)
methods.description: Returns the C++ type of a JIT schema argument.

methods.name: CType returntype_type(t: Type, *, mutable: bool, symint: bool = False)
methods.description: Converts a JIT schema return type into a C++ CType, considering mutability and specific return handling for tensors and lists.

methods.name: CType return_type(r: Return, *, symint: bool = False)
methods.description: Translates a JIT schema return object into its C++ CType.

methods.name: CType returns_type(rs: Sequence[Return], *, symint: bool = False)
methods.description: Generates the combined C++ return type for a list of JIT schema Return objects.

methods.name: Sequence[str] return_names(f: NativeFunction, *, fallback_name: str = "result")
methods.description: Determines the list of output names for a NativeFunction, handling naming conflicts and conventions.

methods.name: str default_expr(d: str, t: Type, *, symint: bool)
methods.description: Converts a JIT default value string into its C++ code representation.

methods.name: list[Binding] argument( a: Argument | TensorOptionsArguments | SelfArgument, *, cpp_no_default_args: set[str], method: bool, faithful: bool, symint: bool = False, has_tensor_options: bool, )
methods.description: Converts a schema argument or special argument into a list of C++ bindings, handling default values and special cases.

methods.name: list[Binding] arguments( arguments: Arguments, *, faithful: bool, symint: bool = False, method: bool, cpp_no_default_args: set[str], )
methods.description: Converts a list of schema arguments into a list of C++ bindings, with options for fidelity and order.

methods.name: list[Binding] sub_argument( a: Argument | TensorOptionsArguments | SelfArgument, )
